notes: total_valid_pixel_visits = sum over pixels of n_contrib[pixel] = total backward replay work units (native state-recovery visits)
surviving_buckets = number of 32-splat buckets that survive the reachability predicate (tile_bucket_idx*32 < tile_max_n_processed)
mean_replay_len ~29-32 of 32: most buckets are nearly full; backward replay processes ~all 32 lanes per pixel
unreachable_pixel_visits = (pixel, bucket) slots visited by the 32-wide backward block but not actually contributing (lane skip via last_contributor) — wasted work the scan would also incur
